sloka: मानुषी मानुषं तं तु राममिच्छसि शोभने ।राज्याद्भ्रष्टमसिद्धार्थं विक्लवं तमनिन्दिते ।। ५.२२.४।।।।
transliteration: mānuṣī mānuṣaṁ taṁ tu rāmamicchasi śobhane ।rājyādbhraṣṭamasiddhārthaṁ viklavaṁ tamanindite ।। 5.22.4।।।।

translations.english: "Love is partial. It gets bound to those in whomsoever compassion and friendship is generated, even though they are punishable.
